title: Revoke GHO
tagline: Revoke GHO token approvals to fake contracts in just 1 click
description: This is a simple project created to protect people from giving erc20 approvals to fake contracts designed to drain token balance from the wallet. This will be very helpful in case of a false signing in a contract and protect the erc20 balance in the wallet.  This is also helpful in protecting funds in a smart contract attack.
how_its_made: The project uses Family connect kit sdk to connect to wallet and then revokes approval from gho contract. Connectkit was very easy to use and connect to wallets and I love the gho stable coin by aave. I used reactjs and typescript in the frontend.  I used reactjs and typescript in the frontend.
